note: Shares are of each ZIP code's or place's residents (2020 Census block populations; land area where a ZIP or place has no residents), placed by each block's internal point on the Census Bureau's 2024 district and place boundaries. ZIP codes are the Census Bureau's ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (2020), which approximate Postal Service delivery areas. For the districts at an exact address, use the Secretary of State's My Voter Page.
